build_LMMamba_model: build a Mamba language model using LMMamba with LMMambaArgs for vocab size and weight tying
create_StateCache_module: create a StateCache module to register conv and state cache buffers for Mamba inference
run_LMMamba_forward: run the LMMamba forward pass with token values and optional targets to get logits or loss
calculate_flops_per_token: calculate the number of FLOPs per token using get_num_flop_per_token with model parameters
reset_LMMamba_parameters: reset LMMamba model parameters using trunc_normal initialization with configurable init_std
